name: preseal-audit
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd()
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(lane.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 r=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert r['exit']==0,(p,r['exit']);assert r['killed'] is None
 receipts.append({'file':p.name,'exit':r['exit'],'wall_s':r['wall_s'],'cpu_s':r['child_cpu_cumulative_s'],'sampled_peak_bytes':r['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes']})
assert json.loads((lane/'frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
assert json.loads((lane/'frozen-before.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
assert len(json.loads((lane/'access-inventory.json').read_text())['direct_GET_attempts'])==11
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'completed-job-audit.json'],input=json.dumps({'completed_receipts':receipts,'frozen_before_after':189,'bad':[],'self_receipt':'preseal-audit.receipt.json produced after this audit; included in final manifest'},indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print('Completed receipts',len(receipts),'all exit 0; frozen before/after189; GET11; batches2')
